data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出新记忆/上下文管理机制：按需重建指导、用先前结果驱动合成，轨迹与结果跨任务保留供后续使用。

scope_support.feedback_quote: An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance
scope_support.object_quote: We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand.
scope_support.persistence_quote: This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible.
